Exact 4-family 22/29-bit shared-prefix factorization (12,928 unique 18-bit prefixes packed into 52 256-lane blocks = 29,952 B prefix RAM; average k4q pass 22,090 ops/claw; deterministic worst-case survivor-free pass 48,364 ops; all 14 guards g1..g15 including g8 interval 16 and g6=17,000 unconditionally bounded, W9C prefilter charged 20 ops/class).

heuristics.statement: Under the screened chaining-value and capped window law of experiments/r39joint_k8.py (k4_scr(cv)<=5, KCAP=679, DTRY=8,192, KTRY=32, 944-claw k4d gate, WMAX_CAP=470,000,000, g8 interval 16, g6=17,000, W9C=20 ops): (i) windows draw independent fresh first blocks M0; (ii) each evaluated F9 claw yields at least EN_LB=4,401,000 F8-passing listed entries and at most MU_D=3,198,000 F8-active distinct keys, uncorrelated with safe claw count s_safe and pre-k4q stamp M_pre(i); (iii) at least R_SAFE_LB=0.931900 of the 944 F9 claws per window satisfy M_pre(i) <= W_SAFE = WMAX_CAP - 3,000,000 = 467,000,000 (which is determined strictly before k4_eval(claw_i), is independent of claw i's W[17] hit and rounds 18..38 tail under H5-w17-uniform and H2-entries, and deterministically guarantees completion under WMAX_CAP with D_stop=0 via the exhaustive 2^32 M_48=107 bound B_CLAW=2,919,873 < 3,000,000), while claw-weighted E[s_w - 1] <= 896; (iv) the p'_k-weighted equal-G co-hit cluster rates over completed-claw keys are bounded by the list-uniform rates PI_BAR=2.31e-3 (for E[min(N_k,3)]) and Q4_UB=3.91e-4 (for P(N_k>=4)).
heuristics.scope: The fixed target sha256-r39-prefix-v1 and the production Attack(win=2^26, k4=True, screen=1, wmax=470000000) path of experiments/r39joint_k8.py.
heuristics.extrapolation: Tuple 124 was selected 100% deterministically by exact algebraic DFA counting (62,955,816 entries, 52 blocks) before any walk or SMC run; 128-window Discovery (seeds 8,000,000..8,000,127) froze only the 5M-rounded scalar WMAX_CAP=470,000,000; exhaustive 2^32 enumeration of s0(y)-y proved M_48=107 and deterministic B_CLAW=2,919,873 < 3,000,000 (W_SAFE=467,000,000, D_stop=0). All 6 empirically estimated constants use exact 6-way Bonferroni simultaneous 99% FWER adjustment (alpha_i=0.01/6): on 256 contiguous disjoint Holdout windows (seeds 8,500,000..8,500,255, 241,664 claws, 944 saturated 256/256, 0 guard violations, 0/241,664 monotonicity violations, max(stamp-M_pre)=106,062), r_safe=0.93756621 (Bonf-6 LCB 0.93197186 -> R_SAFE_LB=0.931900), claw-weighted E[s_w-1]=890.7352 (Bonf-6 UCB 895.9506 -> 896); on 3,776 real screened F9 claws (32 windows x 118 claws, stride 8), 4,427,108.32 F8-entries/claw (Bonf-6 LCB 4,401,870.46 -> EN_LB=4,401,000; matches exact theoretical 62,955,816*9/128=4,426,580.8 to 0.012%; ranks 1..125=4,430,840 vs 126..944=4,426,523) and 3,183,547.15 F8-keys/claw (Bonf-6 UCB 3,197,564.83 -> MU_D=3,198,000); direct capped replay passed 8/8 holdout seeds with m.o<=470,000,000 and exact claw-prefix identity; cohit_all48 measured E[min(N_k,3)]=2.2578e-3 (below uniform 2.3066e-3 < PI_BAR=2.31e-3) and 0/16,384 w-values (0/1.623e11 key-trials) with N_k>=4 (Bonf-6 CP 3.9036e-4 -> Q4_UB=3.91e-4). Organizer-executable r39k4-window-small verifies all 14 guards, full 2^20 k4-off invariance, screening charges, 48/48 planted recovery, and _stamp/M_pre/wmax replay.
heuristics.limitations: The full 2^26 Discovery/Holdout and 16,384-w co-hit panels are participant-run without cryptographic holdout_nonce pre-commitment (though Tuple 124 was selected purely algebraically, holdout seeds are contiguous, theoretical 9/128 F8 density matches to 0.012%, and 6-way Bonferroni FWER adjustment is applied); non-selection of participant panels is therefore a disclosed heuristic limitation. Organizer r39k4-window-small runs bounded 2^20/2^19 windows for mechanical and guard/cap/M_pre replay verification rather than full-scale statistical estimation. Local Docker was unavailable, so organizer experiments await remote intake execution. Extrapolating from 256 holdout windows to ~2^73.94 windows assumes i.i.d. fresh M0 draws and independence of M_pre, s_safe, and equal-G structure from rounds 18..38 tails.

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a W[17]==W17PUB hit of a valid Tuple-124 entry (a2, a3) in F8 x F9 x F10 x F11 (class 01: a0 even, W[1] odd), the full 39-round SHA-256 collision tail probability across rounds 18..38 is at least p_tail = 2^-74.80, and the independent-seed paired SMC estimator provides a calibrated empirical basis for this bound.
heuristics.scope: Rounds 18..38 collision tail of all 62,955,816 valid entries across all 48 kappa groups of Tuple 124 after exact 16-step two-message reconvergence.
heuristics.extrapolation: 28-seed contiguous paired ALL-48 SMC panel (seeds 1..28, NP=100, 4x40x2,048=327,680 trials/seed/arm, 9,175,040 trials/arm) sampling uniformly across all 62,955,816 entries via exact DP vs PUB control on bit-identical SMC carriers (l2 identical on 28/28 seeds; between-seed variance over 28 independent seeds captures within-seed resampling variance): T124-ALL48 yielded 1,246 verified full 39-round collisions (pooled mean 2^-74.37763, Bonf-6 LCB 2^-74.65170, 99.9% LCB 2^-74.67073; class-01 mean 2^-74.32531, Bonf-6 LCB 2^-74.71347, 99.9% LCB 2^-74.74164; paired diff vs PUB +0.01666 bits, seed-mean +0.02237 +- 0.0591 bits). Priced p_tail=2^-74.80 adds 0.087 bits of headroom below the 6-way Bonferroni class-01 LCB, 0.058 bits below the 99.9% class-01 LCB, and 0.422 bits below the pooled mean. Organizer-executable r39-mate-01..14 repeats paired SMC (1x40x2,048 trials/arm) on a single shared SMC carrier across 14 organizer seeds.
heuristics.limitations: Participant 28-seed SMC panel has no cryptographic holdout_nonce pre-commitment (though Tuple 124 was chosen algebraically, seeds 1..28 are contiguous, PUB parity is +0.01666 bits, and p_tail=2^-74.80 sits below the 99.9% class-01 LCB). SMC samples rounds 18..23 from the exact step-16/17 pinned state with uniform F8 x F9 draws for W[8], W[9] and random recovered cv rather than real screened walk claws (a0 even, u odd, k4_scr(cv)<=5). Rounds 18..38 depend on W[2..7] (which enter W[18..23]), and cv enters W[0..5] nonlinearly; k4_scr(cv)<=5 removes ~7.5 bits from 192-bit cv[0..5] while (a0, a1, a2, a3) randomize W[2..7]. Invariance of the tail under cv screening and walk claw selection, as well as SMC estimator calibration and panel non-selection, are therefore explicit heuristic premises of H2-entries. Organizer r39-mate-01..14 awaits remote Docker execution.

heuristics.statement: Across screened F9 claws, the claw-dependent offset (u, w2b) causes each listed key (a2, kappa) to hit W[17]==W17PUB with probability 2^-32, independently of F8 membership, rounds 18..38 tail outcomes, and W[17] hits on other claws.
heuristics.scope: W[17] hit probability in k4q for all 9,906,695 distinct keys of Tuple 124 and cross-claw product in the second-order Bonferroni bound.
heuristics.extrapolation: Algebraic decoupling W[17] = u + s0(a2 + w2b) - a2 - kappa (Section 2.3), 48/48 planted-key recovery + 100-claw random equivalence check (46 survivors observed vs ~45.5 expected, 0 mismatches vs linear scan), and organizer-executable r39-transplant-claw / r39k4-window-small.
heuristics.limitations: Exact 2^-32 W[17] hit probability and independence from rounds 18..38 tails are modeled heuristically; rare ~2^-10 per-claw hits cannot be tested jointly with 2^-74.8 full collisions at scale.

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a colliding Tuple-124 entry (a2, a3), its W[3] word is approximately uniform mod 2^32, so the exhaustive 2^32 bad-set sum max_{a3} sum_{b3!=a3 in group} |B_{b3-a3}| = 3,113,266 bounds within-key mate collision overlap pointwise by eps_mate/2 = 3,113,266 / 2^33 = 3.624319e-4.
heuristics.scope: Within-key mate Bonferroni deduction over all 62,955,816 entries (1,088 classes, 48 groups, 230 distinct mate offsets).
heuristics.extrapolation: Exhaustive 2^32 W[3] enumeration over all 230 distinct mate offsets of Tuple 124 proved 0 zero-Delta occurrences across all 230 offsets and exact pointwise worst-case sum 3,113,266/2^32; 28-seed ALL-48 SMC panel verified W[3] per-bit chi^2(32)=28.72 across 1,246 real hits (99.9% cutoff 62.49) and 0/972 F8-passing mates surviving row 19 (337 at row 18, 635 at row 19); organizer-executable r39-mate-01..14 traces every reached F8-passing mate live.
heuristics.limitations: Exhaustive enumeration proves |B_d| and 0 zero-Delta unconditionally; mapping |B_d|/2^32 to conditional overlap probability relies on W[3] uniformity conditioned on a full collision, tested via 32 marginal bit counts on 1,246 SMC hits rather than proved cryptographically.

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a collision at one claw of a window, another claw's key hit on the same chaining value cv follows the rounds 18..19 trail (and hence collides) with probability at most EPS_KEY = 2^-7.
heuristics.scope: Cross-claw pair term D_cross = (896 * 3,198,000 * 2^-7) / 2^33 = 2.606073e-3 inside the window second-order Bonferroni divisor DIV.
heuristics.extrapolation: 28-seed paired ALL-48 panel tested 1,246 colliding cv clusters (64 virtual other-claw trials per hit -> 79,744 clustered trials per arm, real hit cv vs uniform random cv): xa18=40,152 vs xu18=40,046 (ratio 1.00265) and xa20=0, xu20=0. Because blocks of 64 trials share a single hit cv, we do not claim an i.i.d. n=79,744 Clopper-Pearson bound; EPS_KEY=2^-7 is a declared heuristic ceiling supported by exact parity with the random-cv row-19 survival baseline (~2^-18..2^-22, leaving >8 bits of heuristic headroom even after a 32-mate union bound). Organizer-executable r39-mate-01..14 repeats 32 cross-claw virtual trials/hit drawn from a fresh size-proportional group gi2 across 14 organizer-seeded runs.
heuristics.limitations: Measured on clustered virtual other-claw trials (_xd pins W[17] by solving w[1] without parity restriction) using SMC-generated colliding chaining values rather than real screened-window claw pairs; deeper rows 20..38 are covered by event inclusion. Organizer r39-mate-01..14 awaits remote Docker execution.
